name: Evanston Qualifier 2025
information:
**3x3 will *not* be held at this competition!**

This competition provides one last chance to set qualifying times for the [WCA World Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2025) in July. Please read all tabs before registering.

A music festival (Dillo Day) will take place at Northwestern on Saturday. Parking and traffic may be worse than usual, particularly during and after lunch, so please plan accordingly. If you have not been to Northwestern before, allow at least 15 extra minutes to locate the venue.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
